title: Akiyama Mizuki — Peace And Donuts!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Meow Park

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Man, that was so much fun!
And the big slide was so cute. It was totally plastered with cats!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The handrails had cats hanging from them, and there were even a few climbing up the walls. It was adorably designed...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, this slide is apparently centered around the concept of cats making mischief.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But wow, there are cats pretty much everywhere you look.
You can tell just how much Mr. Inuyama loves them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We really need to thank him. I mean, I didn't think that I'd get to visit such a cute carnival...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we should... So, let's show our appreciation for him by having as much fun at Meow Park as we can!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Next, let's...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Nyantaro's calling to us.
Where should we go next?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. We've sorta gotten used to having Nyantaro be our guide.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Oh, but... I think I'm starting to get a bit hungry.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me too! I'm kinda starved since we've been walking around since this morning.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, Nyantaro, but I think we're gonna grab some lunch before—

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, why'd you stop all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, this is...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The food court!
Talk about perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He was leading us here...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's show him our gratitude by having lunch here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, they have quite a few food trucks here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
One, two... Oh, six in total.
I don't know which to choose...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I believe that's my cue!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The same amount of thought went into the food as the rest of the carnival. It's also all about cats! For example...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that bakery truck!
They sell bread shaped like cat faces!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look at that. They have tabby, white, black and even calico cats! They all look so adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The sardine-broth soba over there is also a must-see. It's got kamaboko with paw prints on it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, even the bowls have cute cats on them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, they are cute...
I'd probably end up taking pictures.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Each truck offers different kinds of cat-themed menu items...! I can't decide which to choose...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. We can take our time here!
Oh, the donuts over there are also really cute...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright!
You guys all have your food?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, Airi, you got every type of bread they had?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I couldn't whittle down my choices.
So, I decided to get them all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I doubt I'll be able to eat all of them, so I'll probably be taking some home with me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You went with donuts, Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, because these cats were so cute!
I actually kinda don't want to eat them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I bought myself some of that soba, and Nene got cat-shaped rice balls. We all went with something different.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, before we start eating, let's take pictures of everything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll send my photos to Saki. This sort of cute cuisine is right up her alley.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Everything's so cute that just taking pictures of it is fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, time to dig in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, Mizuki, look this way for me!
I wanna take your picture!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, thanks!
Peace♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, did it turn out well?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, but... Look who's behind you, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Behind me...? Whoa!
Is that Mikke waving at us from way over there?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He did a pose for us while she was taking the picture.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, just take a look at this picture!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow, there he is...!
That's so sweet of him!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Way to go, Mikke.
He's really got his eye on all the guests.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't think he'd go this far for the guests here! We gotta go thank him later!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We can take pictures with him out in front of the Ferris wheel, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's head over there once we're done eating!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's do that!
